entry.name: serverUrl
entry.label: Address of the runner dashboard (its /api/status is read)

entry.name: pollInterval
entry.label: Seconds between status checks

entry.label: Send a notification when a runner goes offline

entry.label: Send a notification when a job fails

entry.label: Show the offline badge

entry.label: Show the idle badge

entry.label: Show the total number of runners after the badges

entry.label: Send a notification when a local LLM server goes down

entry.label: offline colour
